scientific_integrity: Full four-round game proof for n>=4 and exact finite boundary type recursion. Computational verifiers are included and do not purport to prove the infinite case by sampling.
scientific_limitations: Only uncoloured undirected incidence graphs of order-n Latin squares for n>=2 and quantifier rank <=4; no independent historical-priority clearance or higher-rank classification.
title: A sharp four-round classification of Latin-square incidence graphs
